purpose: Paired observations of supplied staff questions on identical bounded evidence; not specialist acceptance or a price benchmark.
selection_reason: Cover a challenged capital premise, care-home circumstances, cross-manual disability transition, caring conditions and an unanswerable control before observing new model outputs.
tool_policy: No external tools, web retrieval, MCP, memory or project customisations; reject any observed tool event.
model_policy: Existing CLI defaults, no persistent configuration changes; observed model identity and any inability to establish it must be recorded.
retry_policy: One attempt per provider/case/output directory; preserve failure. A subsequent attempt is separate and never overwrites it.
review_policy: Mechanical citation and boundary checks followed by a separately authored claim-level model critique and pending independent human review. No model output is gold.
cost_policy: Record observed usage, elapsed time, retries and provider accounting when available. Subscription charges, future prices and human review cost remain unknown. No affordability conclusion.
